**Herbarium**: A local-only plant specimen accession pipeline for botanical societies. Reads messy CSV/JSONL records, normalizes them into deterministic accession IDs (SHA256 hash of specimen_id + taxon + date), writes to an append-only log, survives process crashes without data loss or duplicates. All flat files, Python stdlib only, no database.

---
